text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
As expected of a GⅠ race.
The atmosphere is on a whole different level!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That's it! There's a breathing technique my mother taught me
back when I was in the children's theater troupe.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's really relaxing,
so why don't we try it together?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"First, stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and place your hands on your stomach.
Be conscious that you're breathing from your belly, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Inhale through your nose... and exhale...
Yeah, yeah, just like that!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
*inhale*... *exhale*...
...Hehe, looks like I was a little nervous too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Amid the quiet sound of their breathing, the murmuring of the crowd drifts in.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Alright, how's that?
Well? Feel a little more relaxed?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, thank goodness.
Well then, I'm off!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Please look forward to my performance.
